from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    mid = w // 2
    left = [row[:mid] for row in grid]
    right = [row[mid + 1:] for row in grid]
    lb = Counter(x for row in left for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rb = Counter(x for row in right for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    shared = set(x for row in left for x in row) & set(x for row in right for x in row)
    common = next(iter(shared))
    if common == lb == rb:
        return [[2 if left[r][c] == common and right[r][c] == common else 3
                 for c in range(mid)] for r in range(h)]
    return [[3 if left[r][c] == common and right[r][c] == common else common
             for c in range(mid)] for r in range(h)]
